themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and South America are mobilizing heavily around upcoming municipal, parliamentary, and presidential elections. Leaders are leveraging polling surges and high-profile candidacies to project imminent government takeover.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Launches large-scale campaign rallies in Andalusia and Valencia while projecting electoral gains over the ruling PSOE.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Gathers municipal endorsements for Marine Le Pen's 2027 presidential bid while maintaining strong poll leads.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Nominates former World Cup footballer Thomas Berthold for federal president and targets power shifts in regional politics.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Rides historic polling surges with Sylvi Listhaug pushing for district mayoral victories and government reduction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Aggressively contests local council by-elections to convert national polling strength into municipal seats.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are intensifying demands to restrict immigration and prioritize native citizens in welfare, housing, and labor markets. Rhetoric framed around national priority is accompanied by calls for aggressive deportations and citizenship reviews.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal champions 'prioridad nacional' in housing and social policy while calling for citizenship reviews of Moroccan nationals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Campaigns against asylum processing hotels and frames illegal immigration as an existential threat to British workers.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Stephen Miller and White House officials enforce executive actions and administrative rules restricting immigration access.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Defends 'remigration' rhetoric and demands a sharp increase in deportations.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Prominent right-wing leaders are engaging in direct cross-border endorsements and alternative foreign policy initiatives to build a unified global anti-left movement and bypass traditional state diplomacy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei issues direct campaign endorsements for Vox leader Santiago Abascal to oust Spain's socialist government.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Leverages public backing from Milei and international conservative partners to frame domestic battles as global anti-socialist crusades.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen offers direct talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Brussels to recalibrate her foreign policy standing.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni leads diplomatic summits in Berlin on Ukraine while advancing sovereign outreach in Africa.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are rallying against state regulation of online speech, algorithms, and media platforms, portraying government oversight and media scrutiny as political censorship.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS-backed President Nawrocki vetoes legislation targeting illegal online content under the banner of defending free speech.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega officials denounce automated bot networks manipulating public debate and targeted harassment on social media.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders collide with independent podcasters and journalists, demanding pre-interview conditions and alleging media bias.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Bolsonarista figures challenge legal restrictions on social media accounts and media bans imposed by judicial authorities.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders and parties face escalating legal pressure, criminal investigations, and intelligence surveillance, which they routinely frame as weaponized establishment persecution.

countries.note: Federal police investigate Bolsonaro film funding while the prosecutor-general upholds a 27-year prison sentence request against the former president.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz appeals to the European Court of Human Rights over term limits while facing a major corruption probe involving buried cash linked to an ex-minister.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces intelligence agency surveillance and renewed legal initiatives aimed at banning the party.
